Name: NPC Chit-Chat
Author: fvjfyjbhm
Description:
English:
A light, non-intrusive mod that makes Pelican Town feel alive. Villagers greet you with tiny speech bubbles when you pass by — no dialogue boxes, no menus, no interruption to your walking. NPCs also chat with each other when they meet, each with their own personality and lines for weather, seasons, time of day, locations, and friendship levels (including spouse lines). Optional emotes pop up alongside the chat.
[list]
[*]Bubble-only: never blocks movement or opens dialogue boxes[/*]
[*]34 NPCs with unique lines; 17 location-based sets; weather, season and time-of-day lines[/*]
[*]Relationship-aware tone: cold at 0 hearts, friendly at 8+, spouse lines[/*]
[*]Frequency fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]中文：
一个很轻量的小 mod，让小镇更有生活气息。村民路过时会在头顶冒气泡问候你——没有对话框、没有菜单，完全不打断你走路。NPC 之间相遇时也会互相冒泡聊天，每个人都有符合性格的台词，还会根据天气、季节、时间段、地点和好感度变化（包括配偶专属台词），偶尔配一个表情。
[list]
[*]纯气泡显示，绝不弹对话、不打断操作[/*]
[*]34 位 NPC 专属台词、17 组地点台词、天气/季节/时间段台词[/*]
[*]按好感度变化语气：0 心冷淡、8 心以上友好、配偶专属[/*]
[*]触发频率可在游戏内配置菜单调整[/*]
[/list]
